findings.text: the project row reports imas-efit as 9, making the displayed subtotal 260; the event census and the research document both show 19, which is required for the stated total of 270.

the reproduction command contains a Python ellipsis and the full per-run receipt exists only at /tmp/measure_final.json, so a later reader cannot rerun or audit the 33/48 and 24/48 derivations after temporary storage is cleaned.
the verdict calls 169 of 224 runs half the population even though the same sentence states 75.4%, understating the unresolved majority and weakening the conclusion's quantitative precision.
the commit subject embeds the plan slug monitor-renders-what-it-is-given, contrary to the repository rule that commit messages contain no plan references.
